title: ExplainerPutSourceInput
description: Arguments for explainer_put_source: upload agent-authored Remotion source into an existing video. Exists because an agent talking to a hosted backend has no disk to write to.

files.description: Files to write, overwriting any file of the same path. The engine-owned files are refused; see the path constraint.

path.description: A relative path built from plain segments. No leading slash, and no segment may begin with a dot, so ".." cannot appear and a write can never escape the video directory. The pattern is deliberately lookahead-free: pydantic v2 compiles it with the Rust regex engine, which has no lookaround. The `not`/`enum` reserves the five engine-owned files listed in manifest.json's engine_owned_files: index.ts, types.ts, Root.tsx, Captions.tsx and Video.tsx mount the narration audio, the caption track and the per-segment sequencing, so an agent that rewrote one could ship a silent video. Only those exact top-level paths are reserved — a nested scenes/Root.tsx is the agent's and stays writable. `not`/`enum` rather than a negative lookahead for the same Rust-regex reason. Both code generators ignore `not`, so this is the published contract and the ajv gate, not the runtime gate; the runtime gate is assertAgentOwnedPaths() in @xplainer/mcp-server.
